'''Swamptoe'''<ref name="AEYNTK" /> was a tamed [[Kaadu]] from the [[planet]] [[Naboo]] who was used as a mount by the [[Gungan]] [[Captain]] [[Roos Tarpals]]. Tarpals rode Swamptoe around the underwater Gungan [[city]] of [[Otoh Gunga]] and as part of the [[Gungan Grand Army]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo]].<ref name="TPM" /> The Captain decorated Swamptoe with feathers that the kaadu had won in races.<ref name="AEYNTK" />
